text: Claudeville 3, attempt 1: goal 100,000 people by 2050 on Medium ($10,000), disasters on, flat map. Plan: one big road grid east of the river, coal power, river pumps, then grow dense.
Main avenue x=76 to the north map edge, 4 streets (y=21,28,35,42).
Homes y22-27, shops y36-38, factories y43-45 (factories farthest from homes).
Coal plant (200 MW, $4,000) next to the factories, power line along x=101 to every zone.
4 water pumps by the river and pipes under every zone row.
